# C391 (inline) — a partial daily_kline must not count as present
2026-10-21 evening: the 17:30/17:36 Baostock attempts timed out at 300s but committed a checkpointed partial daily_kline (1774/5224 rows, quality coverage 0.34, PARTIAL). Reconcile, the postcondition and reindex all treated it as done (baostock_probe_1730 'SUCCEEDED'), and daily_indicators, ladder_daily, stock_day_facts, daily_report_features were derived from the partial set. Fix: coverage < 0.99 → partition not present (keeps fetching, resuming from the checkpoint), postcondition fails with daily_kline_partial:<cov>, reindex refuses to derive. Derived partitions for 10-21 built from the partial kline are removed (backed up) so the program rebuilds them after the complete kline lands.
